cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.27)
project(HicsWaylandProbes LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
find_package(Qt6 6.12.0 EXACT REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui GuiPrivate OpenGL Quick WaylandClientPrivate)
option(HICS_PROBE_ASAN "Instrument the EGL adoption diagnostic (never release runtime)" OFF)
foreach(kind wayland quick)
    add_executable(${kind}-decoration-probe ../qt-${kind}-decoration-probe.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(${kind}-decoration-probe PRIVATE Qt6::GuiPrivate Qt6::OpenGL Qt6::Quick Qt6::WaylandClientPrivate)
endforeach()
add_executable(egl-adoption-probe ../qt-egl-adoption-probe.cpp)
target_link_libraries(egl-adoption-probe PRIVATE Qt6::Gui Qt6::OpenGL)
if(HICS_PROBE_ASAN)
    target_compile_options(egl-adoption-probe PRIVATE -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1)
    target_link_options(egl-adoption-probe PRIVATE -fsanitize=address)
endif()
